 _SUBTHRESHOLD_VETERAN_MATCH: Final[JsonObject] = as_json_object(

@@
 def test_build_profile_grounding_resolves_subthreshold_profile_mirrored_value(
@@
     assert grounding.get("profile_value") == _VETERAN_VALUE, (
         f"grounding must carry the operator's veteran answer, got {grounding}"
     )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("match", "profile", "expected_value", "expected_path"),
+    [
+        pytest.param(
+            _SUBTHRESHOLD_CITIZENSHIP_MATCH,
+            _CITIZENSHIP_PROFILE,
+            _CITIZENSHIP_VALUE,
+            "personal.work_authorization.citizenship",
+            id="citizenship",
+        ),
+        pytest.param(
+            _SUBTHRESHOLD_HISPANIC_ETHNICITY_MATCH,
+            _HISPANIC_ETHNICITY_PROFILE,
+            _HISPANIC_ETHNICITY_VALUE,
+            "preferences.eeo_self_identification.hispanic_ethnicity",
+            id="hispanic-ethnicity",
+        ),
+    ],
+)
+def test_build_profile_grounding_resolves_identity_profile_tangents(
+    ontology: IntentOntology,
+    match: JsonObject,
+    profile: JsonObject,
+    expected_value: str,
+    expected_path: str,
+) -> None:
+    grounding = build_profile_grounding(match, ontology, profile)
+
+    assert grounding is not None, "profile tangent should ground for Class A intent"
+    assert grounding.get("profile_value") == expected_value, (
+        f"grounding should carry profile value {expected_value!r}, got {grounding}"
+    )
+    assert grounding.get("profile_path") == expected_path, (
+        f"grounding should preserve source path {expected_path!r}, got {grounding}"
+    )
*** End Patch
